claims.note: CLAIM REVIEWED (not ours, and not about our data): “Mary Glindon MP said in Parliament that 30% of North Tynesiders are in fuel poverty.” Reviewed by Full Fact (fullfact.org). Their rating, in their words: “Ms Glindon says this figure was misheard, and Hansard has now been updated.
